rules.statement: SFP begins with a false break/sweep of external liquidity from a structural swing or range boundary.
The sweep candle body must close back inside the swept external-liquidity level.
The immediate next candle must open back inside the swept level; only then is SFP formation complete.
After completed SFP formation, move to a lower timeframe and wait for BOS before searching for entry. LTF BOS is not part of SFP object existence.
SFP becomes irrelevant when a later candle body closes beyond the SFP pattern minimum/maximum.
Machine pattern min/max for invalidation is represented by the completed sweep-candle low/high.
External-liquidity parent must already be causally known no later than sweep-candle open; a level discovered after the sweep begins cannot retroactively anchor that SFP.
Sweep is represented as strict penetration beyond the known level; exact touch alone is not a sweep.
SFP formation is source-valid on any timeframe.
H1+ is a preferred search timeframe, not a mandatory validity/admission filter.
SOURCE specifies no finite wait duration for LTF BOS. Any max-wait window is not part of PURE_SOURCE baseline.
If opposite-direction SFP objects form at the same causal time, preserve both objects and mark later setup direction unresolved; do not delete either historical formation.

forbidden_as_source: LTF BOS as a prerequisite for historical SFP object existence
future next-candle HLC data in SFP formation
